Table I as BUCH7.ZPL prints it, on tests/fixtures/lenses/KingslakeDG.zmx at
wavelength 2, object at infinity.  Nine spherical surfaces, EFL 100.003939,
Buchdahl p 0.113648.

WHY THIS FILE EXISTS.  BUCH7_ASPH's stage C runs the scheme four times - direct and
dual, each unfigured then figured.  On a system of spheres the FIRST of those, the
direct unfigured pass, is the spherical scheme exactly, so every one of the 155
entries below must come back unchanged.  That is an entry-by-entry check on the
hardest part of the macro, and a single wrong entry shows as a single wrong line
rather than as a wrong coefficient twenty steps downstream.

The companion file for the CookeTriplet is macros/reference/CookeTriplet_TableI.txt,
which is Buchdahl's own worked example; this one is a second system, with a flat
surface at 5 and an odd number of elements, so the two exercise different branches.

Recorded from the run of 2026-09-15.  Columns are surfaces 1 to 9.
